newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-MARCIO SANTOS SAVES AJAX FROM DEFEAT AGAINST FORTUNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARCIO SANTOS SAVES AJAX FROM DEFEAT AGAINST FORTUNA.

text.p: Marcio Santos saved Ajax Amsterdam from a humiliating defeat with a goal which secured a 2-2 draw against lowly Fortuna Sittard two minutes before the end of their Dutch first division match on Wednesday.
The Brazilian defender converted a penalty given for hands.
Striker Patrick Kluivert opened the scoring in the 13th minute when he turned and shot past goalkeeper Arno van der Zwam.
Kluivert, the best player on the pitch, had further chances for depleted Ajax but failed to beat Van der Zwam again.
Fortuna, who have not won at Ajax since the 1961-62 season, equalised seconds before halftime when English striker Mark Burke headed home.
In the second half the Sittard side, better away than at home, played tightly in defence and patiently waited for a break.
The break came in the 67th minute when Fernando Ricksen outwitted international goalkeeper Edwin van der Sar with a back-heel to make it 2-1.
Ajax piled on the pressure in the final 20 minutes but looked doomed to finish empty-handed until Fortuna conceded the penalty.
Ajax stayed third in the table with 27 points from 15 games.
They are eight points behind leaders Feyenoord, who beat NAC Breda 1-0 on Tuesday, and two behind PSV Eindhoven, who play Sparta Rotterdam on Thursday.
